based_on: eval/match_gold_i3_v1.json new_products (the products ai/eval/i3_match_eval.py adds for --catalog full)
purpose: Demo (I3 heuristic evaluation): products of the 8 I3 test bars that catalog_v2_service.json lacks, so their demo menus can be loaded. Loaded together with catalog_v2_service.json by backend/scripts/seed_catalog.py. Not used by any evaluation.
notes: Fields as in catalog_v2_service.json. Aliases: the standard English name only (as the evaluation's full catalog); no Korean or menu spellings, so customer search finds these products by their English name.
Products of an existing brand point at that brand's id; brands below are new.
IDs: uuid5 with the catalog namespace (README section 8): brand:<key>, balias:<brand key>:<text>, product:<key>, palias:<product key>:<text>.
2026-11-04: Korean brand and product aliases added from i3_additions_ko_aliases.json (add_ko_aliases_i3.py): menu spellings of the I3 test bars and usual transliterations.
